solution.brief:
RULE GENERATOR #03
In default mode, the Rules Generator creates rules between
connections of the same Type (or between all connections,
when Type is not set).
By defining custom grammars in the GR input, in the form 
"ConnectionType>ConnectionType", it is possible to generate
rules between different connection types, and hence generate widely
differentiated aggregations without need to edit all rules. As example,
different connection grammars are defined in different panels for testing.

NB: for the Connection Grammars to work, the TYP input has to either
be left empty or set to False.
